channel.title: Dagster Community Components — Blog
channel.description: Long-form posts from Eric Thomas on the Dagster community components registry — design essays, component tours, honest retrospectives.

item.title: One YAML, every Snowflake object: how the community `snowflake_workspace` component turns Snowflake into a Dagster catalog
item.dc:creator: Eric Thomas
item.description: A tour of the `snowflake_workspace` component — 11+ Snowflake object types as Dagster assets, every Snowflake-native event as a trigger, and Snowflake stays exactly where it is.

item.title: Not every SaaS integration should be a workspace
item.dc:creator: Eric Thomas
item.description: A design essay on when to build a `_workspace` component, when to build a `_resource + _sink` pair, and how to tell the difference. Includes the taxonomy behind the community-components reshape of Notion, GitHub, Jira, and PagerDuty.
